method: Derived by reading the shipped result card and its upstream normalizer, not by assuming the usual title/price/image/retailer set. The shipped card was identified from eas.json, which sets EXPO_PUBLIC_SCAN_RESULTS_V2_UI=true in all four governed profiles (preview, development, staging, production), so app.js:1134 renders ScanResultV2 and the tappable row is a PurchaseOptionsPanel row.

shipped_card.note: components/ProductShelf.tsx is the LEGACY shelf and is not imported by anything under components/scan-results/. It remains reachable on the reopened Recent Scan surface only.

panel_level_gates.enforced_at: components/AnalysisCard.tsx:135 (resolvePurchaseShelfMode) — a remote kill switch that hides the shelf regardless of data

minimum_actionable.requirement: productUrl must additionally survive validation, not merely be present.
rules: hostname must exist and must not be a private/loopback/link-local host
minimum_actionable.failure_behaviour: the row still renders but the CTA is replaced by an inert 'Unavailable' label (PurchaseOptionsPanel.tsx:128-150). In practice a URL-less entry was already dropped upstream at commerceHydration.ts:151, so the two paths disagree about which layer removes it.

explicitly_NOT_required.finding: The shipped purchase row renders NO product image at all — retailer, title, price and availability text plus the CTA. Image bytes are therefore not on the TTFAR critical path for the primary shelf.

explicitly_NOT_required.fallback: not read by the shipped row

secondary_surface.gate: ScanResultV2.tsx:58-76 isRenderableSimilarFind, then ScanResultV2.tsx:262 requires renderableSimilarFinds.length >= 2
secondary_surface.consequence: a single valid similar find renders nothing at all
secondary_surface.divergence: SimilarFindsShelf.tsx:70 gates onPress on raw truthiness of product.productUrl rather than on isSafeCommerceUrl, so an http:// or private-host URL renders a fully pressable card whose tap silently does nothing (openExternalUrl returns false and the boolean is discarded with `void`). Recorded as an adjacent defect, not repaired by this lane.

does_image_load_block_actionability.reason: The primary row has no image. On the secondary ProductCard, hasImage only selects <Image> vs a placeholder (ProductCard.tsx:51-70); onPress at :102-113 is independent of it.

do_secondary_fields_block_the_card.reason: Every non-required field has a fallback or is simply omitted from the row.

canonical_minimum.title: non-empty string
canonical_minimum._comment: Two fields. That is the entire actionable-result contract for the shipped shelf.
